baseline_observations: The page is a static display presenting a list (#bands) of band names.
No interactive controls (buttons, links, form inputs) exist in the original example.
Keyboard tab navigation cannot reach any element since the page contains no focusable elements.
A skip-to-content link is needed to allow keyboard users to navigate directly to the #bands content region.
decision: Add an accessible skip-to-content link targeting #bands that becomes visible upon focus, ensure distinct visible focus outline, avoid positive tabindex, and implement the band sorting logic in index-START.html.
